attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared, sticky-bit-protected writable directory using an Ansible playbook run from node2 (the control node, chosen because it has Ansible and existing SSH keys). Fixed node1's SSH (missing host keys blocked sshd) and set up root key trust so node2 could orchestrate it. Verified sticky-bit behavior functionally with two test users, then restarted both node1 and node2 one at a time, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery after each restart.
